resources.string: Automatic: hide while a physical keyboard is available

Supports tablet keyboard covers, USB and Bluetooth keyboards. Pair or attach in Android first. Existing game key bindings apply. Hidden controls do not intercept touches. Changes are saved automatically. In game: Settings > Joypad.
Higher values make controls more visible. Applies to the joystick, buttons and skill icons. Assign skills to keys 0–6 in Keybinds.
